chapter_length.notes: New or substantively updated chapters entering future release inventory must contain at least 2000 non-whitespace正文 characters. There is no maximum chapter length or preferred cap. Existing historical chapters are not retroactively blocked by this publishing gate unless they are being updated.

daily_word_floor.notes: Every normal release day is exactly three consecutive chapters at 00:00 Asia/Shanghai and must contain at least 6000 non-whitespace正文 characters. Partial release days and auto-continue scheduling are forbidden.

notes: Author confirmed on 2026-09-11 that the future cadence is three chapters per day. From chapter 159 onward, each normal day publishes exactly three consecutive audited chapters at 00:00 Asia/Shanghai; every new or substantively updated chapter has at least 2000正文 characters and each three-chapter day totals at least 6000. Existing chapters 134-158 already scheduled for 2026-09-11 through 2026-09-15 are not rescheduled by this policy change. Future creates must use an explicit fixed start date. A fresh read-only reconcile is required before platform mutation.
